lines.text: Why does almost every country on Earth collect taxes?
Most people assume the government just takes your hard-earned money.
Zero taxes sounds great, until roads crumble and emergency services crash.
Taxes are actually the shared subscription fee of a modern civilization.
Every dollar flows through three main pipelines: income, sales, and property.
The engine redistributes that capital back into public security, clean water, and roads.
Inside the national budget, collective purchasing makes public services ten times cheaper.
Pooling resources delivers over five trillion dollars in shared infrastructure.
So taxes are not a penalty, they are the engine that keeps modern society running.
